content:
emma: Proposal: require preview=true for non-admin canaries by default. API returns preview_id (lightweight). Emit structured telemetry so console can correlate preview vs live. Thoughts?

kai: +1. Migration: warn mode for 30d then enforce. Also add X-Config-Apply-Id header for idempotency.

mohit: Implementation note: preview=true creates a minimal preview artifact (diff + metadata). Compute preview_digest (sha256). Persist metadata 14d, full blobs only if cohort>=1% or user requests.

daria: Console UX: show compact normalized diff, provenance, and cohort slider. Panels: heatmap (cohort_pct vs error_rate) and preview->apply delta timeseries.

emma: Telemetry events: config.preview_created, config.apply_attempt, config.apply_result. Include preview_id, preview_digest, cohort_pct, actor_role, idempotency_key.

kai: If enforcement on and non-admin hits apply without preview, return 409 + X-Config-Preview-Help. Metric: config.apply.blocked_preview count.

mohit: Trace sampling: 0.1% sample for previewed cohorts; attach preview_id+digest in internal trace metadata, signed URL surfaced in console.

daria: I'll mock dashboard queries and compact diff renderer.

emma: Action items: kai -> API PR, mohit -> preview store + digest, daria -> console + telemetry panels, emma -> short RFC. Ops-bot: please annotate audits when preview exists.

ops-bot: OpsBot: snapshot created for config route-quota-v4 preview p_f3d2 @5512345678 :white_check_mark:
